method.scope: One synthetic MoE feedforward block: FP32 router/top-k/softmax, BF16 grouped gate/up GEMM, FP32 SwiGLU math with one BF16 cast, BF16 grouped down GEMM, and FP32 weighted combine. Shared weights and GEMM backend across all variants. This is not complete language-model inference.
method.timing: CUDA events after warmup; router/expert computation included in forward. Expert stages include both GEMMs and activation. Per-stage medians are measured in isolation and need not sum to the full-forward median. Compilation and validation are excluded; eager samples can include CPU launch gaps. Persistent buffers exclude shared weights and backend temporary allocations. Optional graph timing is separate.
